channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US bombs Iran for eighth-straight night
item.description: The US has launched a new wave of strikes on Iran after two American soldiers were killed by Iranian strikes in Jordan.

item.title: Moment Iranian missiles hit airbase in Jordan killing US soldiers
item.description: A video captures the moment an Iranian missile struck Jordan’s Muwaffaq Salti Airbase, killing two US service members.

item.title: At least one killed as Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv
item.description: Russian missiles struck Kyiv and the surrounding region early on Sunday, killing at least one person and injuring nine.

item.title: US hits Iran for eighth consecutive night, Iran returns fire on Gulf bases
item.description: Sirik and Hajiabad areas in Iran's Hormozgan province targeted as US says revenge for killing of two soldiers.

item.title: Iran war live: US bombs Iran; Trump says soldiers killed ‘a sad thing’
item.description: US forces attack Iran for the eighth consecutive night as Iran says MoU 'suspended'.

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes after two US deaths in Jordan attack
item.description: US forces target Iranian sites for the eighth night in a row, while Iran says it fired drones at the US military in Kuwait.

item.title: Laos says it can't determine cause of tourist deaths linked to methanol
item.description: Officials say they have no evidence of poisoning over the 2024 deaths because autopsies were not conducted.

item.title: What this desert city can teach the world about tackling heat deaths
item.description: Maricopa County in Arizona has some of the hottest temperatures, but it has reduced the number of heat-related deaths.

item.title: Watch: What to know as Genoa bridge disaster trial ends
item.description: More than 50 defendants have been on trial in Italy over the 2018 bridge collapse which killed 43 people.
